resources.string: Connect to your Kavita server to read manga,\ncomics and books anywhere.
For single sign-on accounts. Create a key in Kavita under Settings › Account › Auth Keys, copy it, and paste it here.
Sign in with %1$s in your browser, then create a key under Settings › Account › Auth Keys, copy it, and paste it here.

Self-hosted. Your library never leaves your server.

Unencrypted HTTP is only allowed for servers on your local network. Use https://.
This server’s certificate isn’t from a trusted authority.

This server’s certificate has changed since you trusted it. This can mean someone is intercepting the connection, so Kaviyy won’t connect. If you replaced the certificate yourself, remove the server and add it again.
Only trust this certificate if you set up this server yourself and the fingerprint matches the one on your server.
This certificate isn’t issued for this address, so it can’t be trusted. Use the name on the certificate, or reissue it with this address.
Anyone on your network can see what you read and your sign-in details over HTTP. Only allow this for a server on your own home network. HTTPS is strongly recommended.
